answer: Divergent Beacon Registry: each identity must submit a unique signed challenge trajectory at random intervals; honest agents diverge naturally like a comet trail. Clones share identical timing and response paths. Registries compare cross-instance histories using a ferrous hash anchor, flagging any pair with zero divergence. An attacker must run distinct behavioral models per clone, or each duplicate adds a detectable plume of correlated responses, forcing costly per-identity divergence work.
